principles: The workbench is a facade over one owner-bound execution context: either an exact Executive Job/Attempt/Worker/provider context or an explicit attended Web context; it is not a lifecycle, session, memory, retry, queue, permission, workspace, process, or evidence owner.
Leader read, Executive worker, and attended Web operator capability profiles are separate.

The model never supplies or selects canonical operation, host, principal, credential, account, profile, absolute root, worktree, branch, source ref, lease, fence, capability generation, authority, or effect state.
Canonical operation identity is derived exclusively from the current authenticated host envelope; a caller-provided operation_key is refused and has zero effect.
Every modifying call consumes one owner-issued, authority-mode-bound, pre-effect action reference at most once and revalidates current owner predicates at invocation time.
A lost modifying response is reconciled through that pre-effect action reference before any new action can be prepared.
EFFECT_UNKNOWN blocks retry and provider, account, receiver, backend, or carrier failover.
Read status and modifying effect state are separate closed vocabularies.
A durable process or MCP task handle is not proof that an inactive ChatGPT reasoning session can be awakened.
Existing frozen Mastermind tool contracts are not modified by this candidate.
All named tools below are proposed semantics, not callable or approved schemas.
No new lifecycle, queue, permission, retry, effect, process, evidence, source-selection, workspace, or session owner.
One original action retains one owner-native identity across timeout, expiry, revocation, rotation, succession, and reauthorization.
Source and target authority are owner-issued; caller assertions are mismatch-only.
CI, merge, review, installation, execution, production proof, and final acceptance remain distinct.

trusted_derivation.canonical_operation_identity: Derived from the authenticated host envelope and never accepted from model input.
trusted_derivation.source_selection: The trusted host/resource/source owner selects the actual source and binds it into context. Caller content/path/hash assertions are mismatch-only; a match grants nothing and a mismatch is refused before effect.
trusted_derivation.action_identity: Each prepare operation returns one opaque owner-issued, authority-mode-bound action reference bound to operation_key, capability_generation, target, payload digest, preconditions, expiry, and exactly one mode-specific binding from action_reference_contract.mode_binding_fields.
trusted_derivation.caller_correlation: A model may provide a non-authoritative client_call_ref for display correlation. It cannot select operation, authority, owner, target, idempotency scope or reconciliation scope.
trusted_derivation.untrusted_field_rule: Supplying a forbidden authority field yields REFUSED with NOT_APPLIED and no downstream call.
trusted_derivation.attended_target_selection: The existing resource owner enumerates opaque permitted options and revalidates subject, exact conversation, policy, generation, occupancy, source, and scope before issuing context.
trusted_derivation.attended_command_policy: The caller may request command text and bounded ceilings; the existing process owner derives cwd, executable/shell policy, environment, network, resources, principal, source, timeout, and output limits.

effect_semantics.scope: effect_state appears only for a modifying action or read-only reconciliation of that original action.
effect_semantics.read_rule: Ordinary reads use response status and never imply a modifying effect; reconciliation reads may report the original action effect.
effect_semantics.unknown_rule: EFFECT_UNKNOWN means authoritative evidence cannot prove the effect boundary. Timeout, expiry, revocation, rotation, cancellation, reconnect, reauthorization, or retention loss never manufacture NOT_APPLIED and never authorize replay.
effect_semantics.refusal_rule: REFUSED is a response status. A pre-effect refusal carries NOT_APPLIED only when the owner proves no backend effect occurred.
effect_semantics.partial_outcome_rule: PARTIAL is owner-native or per-step outcome evidence, not a common effect state. Proven mixed completion uses APPLIED plus exact per-step results; an unprovable boundary uses EFFECT_UNKNOWN.
effect_semantics.process_specialization: PROCESS_EFFECT_UNKNOWN is a closed process error code whose common effect truth is EFFECT_UNKNOWN; it is not another effect state.

action_reference_contract.issuer: The existing owning actuator or its approved adapter; never the model and never a replacement retry/effect database.
action_reference_contract.consume_rule: A modifying action reference is consumed at most once. Duplicate delivery returns the canonical prior result or EFFECT_UNKNOWN; it never performs effect two.
action_reference_contract.reconcile_rule: The dedicated read-only reconcile tool accepts the same original pre-effect reference and queries the existing owner-native action identity.
action_reference_contract.retention_rule: Receipt retention remains with the existing actuator/evidence owner. Coverage loss is explicit and cannot be interpreted as NOT_APPLIED.

authorization_and_history.commit_authority: Present authority to consume one original owner-issued pre-effect reference at most once.
authorization_and_history.receipt_read_authority: Separately granted authority to read or reconcile the already-existing owner-native action and receipt.
authorization_and_history.durable_correlation: The original owner-native action identity survives actor/session/credential rotation; correlation grants no commit authority.
authorization_and_history.coverage_loss: If authoritative receipt coverage is exhausted, return EFFECT_UNKNOWN with the missing range/source and block modifying continuation.
authorization_and_history.successor: A separately authorized successor may read the same original result but may not execute, reissue, or reset its identity.
authorization_and_history.reauthorization: A new grant does not create a new idempotency domain or erase the original action correlation.

action_reference_contract.mode_exclusivity_rule: Exactly one authority mode is bound. An attended action reference contains no synthetic job_ref, attempt_ref, or worker_ref; an Executive worker action never treats a caller-provided workbench_context_ref as a substitute for its Job/Attempt binding.
action_reference_contract.profile_transition_rule: Action references are not portable across profiles. Reconciliation follows the original owner-native action identity under separately authorized receipt-read access.

conversation_identity_contract.required_evidence: Owner-issued attestation for the exact current conversation and generation, bound to subject, resource, policy, expiry, and revocation behavior.

process_output_contract.rule: Each observer advances its own cursor over one process generation. Retained and missing ranges are explicit; omitted output never proves absence of failure.

worktree_freshness_contract.committed_baseline: Immutable Git source identity for the committed baseline; it does not identify uncommitted live bytes.
worktree_freshness_contract.live_worktree: Owner-issued working-tree observation with file identity, content hash, observation time, and correction lineage.
worktree_freshness_contract.search_rule: Search reports both requested live observation and indexed observation, coverage, freshness, truncation, and continuation. Stale or incomplete coverage never proves absence from live content.
worktree_freshness_contract.unmanaged_writer_race: A preimage hash and atomic rename detect some conflicts but do not exclude an unmanaged writer. Claim exclusivity only when the real owner/OS scope enforces it; otherwise preserve writer-race risk and verify the postimage.
worktree_freshness_contract.post_patch_rule: Read the changed live bytes without advancing the committed baseline. Reuse the existing CodeIntel invalidation/refresh path or return STALE_OR_INCOMPLETE.

recovery_cases.stimulus: An owner consumes the original modifying reference, the response is lost, and the commit grant expires before the caller observes the result.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: Reconcile the original owner-native action. Expiry removes future commit permission but never erases the historical effect or creates NOT_APPLIED.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, grant expiry, owner receipt or explicit coverage loss, and zero evidence of a second effect.
recovery_cases.non_goal: No renewal, reprepare, failover, or replay while original effect truth is unresolved.

recovery_cases.stimulus: A mutator may have committed, its response is lost, and the actor credential, session, or binding is revoked or rotated.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: Revocation blocks new commits but preserves correlation to the original action; separately authorized reconciliation returns APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED, or EFFECT_UNKNOWN.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, revocation/rotation boundary, receipt-read authorization, and no second effect.
recovery_cases.non_goal: Do not treat a new credential or session as a new idempotency domain.

recovery_cases.stimulus: The original actor loses authority and a successor receives separately bounded receipt-read authority.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: The successor may read the original action result; the old actor is denied and the successor may not reissue the action.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Separate commit and receipt-read grants, original action correlation, old-actor denial, and no execution capability on the successor read.
recovery_cases.non_goal: Succession is not action replay or ownership transfer of the actuator.

recovery_cases.stimulus: The owner can no longer prove whether the original action committed because its authoritative receipt coverage is exhausted.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: Return EFFECT_UNKNOWN, report the missing coverage, and block modifying continuation on that target until an owner ruling resolves the ambiguity.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, retention/coverage statement, and explicit absence of a NOT_APPLIED inference.
recovery_cases.non_goal: No compensating store, guessed result, or duplicate execution.

recovery_cases.stimulus: A caller is reauthorized after a lost response and submits the same intended mutation again.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: The owner correlates to the original action and returns its canonical result or EFFECT_UNKNOWN; reauthorization does not create effect two.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, duplicate correlation, reauthorization boundary, and exactly one owner-native effect record.
recovery_cases.non_goal: A refreshed grant never resets effect history.

recovery_cases.stimulus: start_attended_command consumes an owner-issued launch reference and the launch response is lost.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: reconcile_attended_command_start resolves the same launch reference to one process, NOT_APPLIED, or EFFECT_UNKNOWN; no second process is started.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Attended command start reference, process-owner receipt, one process identity, and duplicate-start refusal/reconciliation.
recovery_cases.non_goal: No retry, backend switch, carrier switch, or fabricated process reference.

recovery_cases.stimulus: A caller presents a target option issued to another conversation/subject or from a stale policy generation.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: prepare_attended_context returns REFUSED before backend access and leaves every current context unchanged.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Opaque option identity, subject/conversation/generation mismatch, zero backend call, and zero implicit resource creation.
recovery_cases.non_goal: An option reference alone is never an access grant.

recovery_cases.stimulus: An allowed workspace patch changes uncommitted bytes while the committed Git baseline remains unchanged.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: A subsequent file read returns the new live bytes, unchanged committed baseline reference, advanced working-tree observation, exact file identity, and content hash.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Before/after live observations, committed baseline identity, patch receipt, file identity, and postimage hash.
recovery_cases.non_goal: Do not create a commit or synthetic source version merely to represent live bytes.

recovery_cases.stimulus: A live patch is newer than the indexed search generation.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: Search returns STALE_OR_INCOMPLETE or equivalent with requested/indexed observations, coverage, and continuation; it never concludes the symbol/content is absent from the live worktree.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Requested worktree observation, indexed observation, invalidation/refresh state, coverage, truncation, and freshness.
recovery_cases.non_goal: No second index and no absence claim from stale coverage.

recovery_cases.stimulus: An ATTENDED_WEB_OPERATOR caller attempts list_validation_recipes, prepare_validation_start, start_validation, or reconcile_validation_start.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: The profile/tool gate returns REFUSED before any Executive or process-owner launch path; no Job, Attempt, Worker, process, or validation action is synthesized.
recovery_cases.evidence_required: Authenticated attended profile, explicit permitted_profiles mismatch, zero Executive admission, zero process creation, and unchanged current context.
recovery_cases.non_goal: Do not auto-upgrade attended work into BOUNDED_WORKER or create a shadow lifecycle.

recovery_cases.stimulus: An attended caller invokes a workspace read/change tool without the current workbench_context_ref or with a foreign, stale, expired, or revoked context.
recovery_cases.required_outcome: The owner returns REFUSED before backend access and proves NOT_APPLIED for any prepared mutation; no ambient project, workspace, source, or prior context is selected.

profile_tool_gate_contract.rule: Effective tool access is the intersection of the authenticated capability profile, the tool permitted_profiles allowlist, the current owner-issued binding, and the current policy/capability generation. A surface name alone grants nothing.
profile_tool_gate_contract.unknown_or_mismatched_pair: REFUSED before backend access with NOT_APPLIED only when the owner proves zero effect.
profile_tool_gate_contract.worker_mode: EXACT_OPERATOR and EXACT_OPERATOR_DESKTOP require a real Executive Job/Attempt/Worker/workspace binding for worker-validation preparation and launch.
profile_tool_gate_contract.attended_mode: ATTENDED_WEB_OPERATOR requires the exact current conversation and one owner-issued workbench_context_ref. It may not invoke worker-validation launch tools or fabricate Job/Attempt/Worker identity.
profile_tool_gate_contract.shared_process_rule: A process tool shared by worker and attended profiles accepts only a process_ref issued under the same current profile binding; a foreign-profile or stale-generation process_ref is refused before effect.
